snippet.title: Stupid Never Dies | Second Trailer
snippet.description:
** Recommended with subtitles on （字幕ON推奨）**
Coming Fall 2026. WISHLIST NOW!! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/34...

Julia has frozen to death. Monsters roam the streets. How did the world end up like this…?

Davy, the timid zombie protagonist, has one dream: to bring Julia back to life and take her on a date.
To make that dream come true, he ventures into a dangerous otherworldly dungeon.

There will be times when powerful enemies leave him completely battered—but with the support of his eccentric companions, Davy keeps pushing forward.

Bite, Rip, Rise to your way to the top!
Stupid Never Dies—the underdog adventure of the weakest zombie rising against all odds.


2026年秋、発売決定！

凍死してしまったジュリア。街を歩き回るモンスターたち。
なぜ、こんな世界になってしまったのか――？
ヘタレゾンビの主人公・デイビィの夢は、ジュリアを甦らせてデートすること。
その願いを叶えるため、危険な異世界ダンジョンへと挑む！
強敵との戦いでボコボコにされることもあるが、個性豊かな仲間たちに支えられながら前へ進むデイビィ。

喰らい、奪い、這い上がる、最弱ゾンビの成り上がり冒険譚。それがステューピッド・ネバー・ダイズ！



Title Name : Stupid Never Dies 
Release Year : Fall 2026 
Genre : Blazing Fast Growth 3D Action RPG 
Player# : Single play 
Platforms : PS5, PC (Steam) 
ESRB: M
Official X ： https://x.com/stupidnvrd
